actions.basis: ESPN weekly projections for this week and the next four. Add/drop pairs are alternatives, not cumulative. No acquisition, drop or waiver is executed. Kicker and defense streams replace the incumbent at that position to preserve skill-position depth. Future bye plans require a fresh check that week; injury uncertainty and waiver cost still require review.

lineup.status: Hold — no swap clears the threshold

comparisons.definition: Efficiency = actual starting points / hindsight best legal lineup points. Season averages are arithmetic averages of completed weeks. Missing or mismatched historical rosters are excluded and aggregate efficiency is unavailable if coverage is incomplete.

trades.verdict: Exploratory only — marginal benefit or near-term cost; hold for now
